levels.surface: العلاء بن عبد الرحمن بن يعقوب

notes: two «ح» routes that each repeat their names, so separate groups; «بمثل حديث سفيان» names another transmitter for the same saying, kept as a variant group and never a route; «مولى هشام بن زهرة» and «مولى بني عبد الله» are patronage and left out; «وفي حديثهما» adds wording to the saying only, left out
